name: TickerHQ
author: Viraj Patil

sections.description:
TickerHQ allows you to create:

  • Top Gainers Widgets
  • Top Losers Widgets
  • Horizontal Scrolling Tickers
  • Dark and Light Themes
  • Responsive Stock Widgets

External Services

TickerHQ connects to the Alpha Vantage API to retrieve stock market data.

Service Provider:
https://www.alphavantage.co

Terms of Service:
https://www.alphavantage.co/terms_of_service/

Privacy Policy:
https://www.alphavantage.co/privacy/

Data Sent:
– Alpha Vantage API key entered by the site administrator
– Market data requests

This service is contacted only when the administrator performs a market synchronization.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin.
  2. Activate plugin.
  3. Sync market data.
  4. Create widget.
  5. Use shortcode.
sections.faq:
Does this require an API key?

Yes.

TickerHQ requires a free Alpha Vantage API key.

You can obtain one here:

https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key

Does it support Elementor?

Yes.
